reference.sourceDescription: FlahaX reference mixture generated from official PHREEQC source commit at 25 C; CaCl2 2 mmol/kgw, MgCl2 1 mmol/kgw, NaH2PO4 1 mmol/kgw.

phreeqcInput:
TITLE FlahaX calcium-magnesium-phosphate reference mixture
SOLUTION 1
    temp 25
    pH 6.5
    units mmol/kgw
    Ca 2
    Mg 1
    P 1 as H2PO4
    Na 1
    Cl 6
SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -file ca_mg_phosphate_probe.sel
    -reset false
    -pH true
    -ionic_strength true
    -totals Ca Mg P Na Cl
    -molalities Ca+2 Mg+2 PO4-3 HPO4-2 H2PO4-
    -activities Ca+2 Mg+2 PO4-3 H+
    -si Hydroxyapatite
END
